---
title: "Gallery"
toc: false
page-layout: full
# Masonry photo gallery (andrewheiss/quarto-static-photo-gallery). The
# extension runs `uv run` on each render to make thumbnails in img/thumbs/
# (gitignored) and read captions from img/album.yml.
extensions:
  photo-gallery:
    album-files: img
    layout: masonry
    columns: 3
    gap: 8
    thumbnail-height: 600
    show-exif: false
    date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
---

{{< photo-gallery >}}

```{=html}
<script>
// Newest first. The extension orders photos by filename, and the filenames
// start with the date, so reverse them. This runs while the page is parsed,
// before photo-gallery.js sets up the lightbox on DOMContentLoaded, so the
// lightbox order and counter follow the new order.
for (const gallery of document.querySelectorAll(".photo-gallery .pswp-gallery")) {
  [...gallery.children].reverse().forEach((el) => gallery.appendChild(el));
}
</script>
```
